label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (ssrf): alert-TP. User-controlled param flows to URL.openStream() at line 44. Although isNonPublicAddress() checks the resolved IP, it only blocks loopback/site/local/link-local/any-local addresses. Attacker can provide hostname resolving to public IP (bypassing the check). Also, the validation uses parsed.getHost() but the actual fetch uses original 'u' parameter - potential mismatch. The isNonPublicAddress() check is insufficient to prevent SSRF attacks.

evidence.note: User param flows through URL parsing, DNS resolution check, then to openStream() - insufficient SSRF prevention
